geographies.label: Switzerland
geographies.limitations: Only the global ISCO-08 reference is held; no Swiss national classification or source is identified or assessed.

geographies.label: United States
geographies.limitations: O*NET (1,016 occupations) and BLS data are held and the strongest coverage. Native SOC and O*NET-SOC codes are not persisted in the runtime store, so compensation and outlook records are not joined to occupations by code (P10C-B). Not qualified.

geographies.label: Canada
geographies.limitations: NOC (Statistics Canada) and the Job Bank wage data were identified in planning only; nothing is acquired, assessed for licence, or held. P10C-D added an adapter contract and a province and territory vocabulary (synthetic fixtures only): no occupation node, crosswalk or compensation record exists, so no level is raised and nothing is qualified.

geographies.label: Mexico
geographies.limitations: SINCO (INEGI) was identified in planning only; nothing is acquired or assessed for licence. P10C-D added an adapter contract and a state vocabulary (synthetic fixtures only): no occupation node, crosswalk or compensation record exists, so no level is raised and nothing is qualified.

geographies.label: Brazil
geographies.limitations: CBO was identified in planning only; nothing is acquired or assessed for licence. P10C-D added an adapter contract and a state vocabulary (synthetic fixtures only): no occupation node, crosswalk or compensation record exists, so no level is raised and nothing is qualified.
